read_policy.package_metadata: bounded JSON/XML and opaque recorded hashes only
read_policy.native_bi4_arrays: not read by source package; unchanged Root converter reads them later
read_policy.raw_tree: Root converter read-only hashes complete native tree before and after conversion

input_closure_policy: Every disabled request has input_files and input_sha256 with identical key sets. Actual non-BI4 file hashes are recomputed during package validation; BI4 inputs retain immutable recorded hashes and are not opened.
native_data_policy: Each request points at its own actual Root146 native data root; no /tmp alias substitutes a DATA path.
